extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic performance figures digitised: Figure 1a-d, Figure 4a, and Figure 10a-b. Product-yield bars in Figures 1a, 1d, and 4a are not stored because the schema has no methanol-yield/CO-yield field; only plotted CO2 conversion, CH3OH selectivity, and the plotted/text-linked STY value are recorded. Figures 7-9 are in situ DRIFTS spectra and intermediate ratios, not direct catalytic performance outputs, and were skipped. Figure 11 is DFT and was skipped. Some closely spaced bars/dots in Figure 1b and Figure 1c-d are approximate visual readings; ambiguous high-pressure points are flagged in notes.
